description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified honeypot template
description_zh: 更改指定的蜜罐模板配置
name: UpdateHoneypotPreset

parameters.help_en: The name of the honeypot image
parameters.name: honeypot_image_name

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the honeypot template
parameters.name: preset_name

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the honeypot template.
You can call the [ListHoneypotPreset](~~ListHoneypotPreset~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
蜜罐模板唯一ID。
调用[ListHoneypotPreset](~~ListHoneypotPreset~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: honeypot_preset_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom parameters of the honeypot template. The value is a JSON string that contains the following fields:
portrait_option: social tracing
burp: Burp countermeasure
trojan_git: Git countermeasure
parameters.help_zh:
蜜罐模板自定义参数，格式为JSON格式的字符串。包含以下字段：
portrait_option：社交溯源
burp：Burp反制
trojan_git：Git反制
parameters.name: meta

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of a failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 请求数据结果的HTTP状态码

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
